name: Small business loan agreements from the loan system
description: The loan system starts the workflow by API with the borrower, amount, APR and term, and a co-borrower when there is one. The workflow prepares the loan agreement's eSignature template with those values; each borrower passes knowledge-based authentication (US KBA) before signing, then the officer countersigns. Without a co-borrower, the template has no co-borrower role.
prerequisites: The loan system calls the workflow's API trigger as the loan officer (a human start).
ID Verification with the US KBA workflow ("IDV (US KBA)") is enabled on the account; KBA is US-only.

KBA is set on the eSignature template's borrower roles (per-role ID Verification), so each borrower answers it when they open the envelope. To check a borrower before the agreement is prepared instead, a Verify Someone's Identity step with "configuration": "kba" does it in the workflow.

gaps.need: the payment schedule chosen per loan
gaps.instead: the templates fix monthly payments: a dropdown in an eSignature template is fixed at build time

integration: The loan system sends `apr` as TEXT with two decimals ("7.50", not 7.5): the eSignature template's tab prints the value exactly as sent, and a number would print "7.5".
